text: Explore a new dimension in chart analysis. This update brings an interactive 3D levels scanner, refreshed Pattern X-Ray and Liquidity Guard visuals, cinematic motion controls, and clearer scanner typography. Explore supporting evidence and opposing scenarios, switch between completed timeframes, and open the illustrative demo faster. We have also reduced interface clutter, improved mobile layouts and accessibility, and made subscription and restore actions easier to find. Analysis remains educational and should be verified against your chart.
